name: The Schoolhouse
description: Each teacher at the schoolhouse leads a different class in a different room. Work out who teaches what, and where.
clues: Music, Liam, and Mona go with Choir, Scouts, and Yearbook, in some order.

Art goes with exactly one of Boyd, Mona, or Rowing.

Either Art goes with Mona or Noah goes with Rowing.
